'''Atzerri''' was a tradeworld in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]], near the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]]. This [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was a member of the [[Association of Free Trade Worlds]] and only had as much government as necessary to stave off total chaos.

==Geography==
The planet consisted of mostly marshes and cities where almost anything, legal or illegal, could be had for a price. Arriving visitors ran a gauntlet of gaudily lit stores known as [[Trader's Plaza]], designed to hook new arrivals and separate them from their credits as soon as possible. With little regulation, Atzerri was a world of grandiose free market policies and utter corruption. [[Atzerri Air Traffic Control]] guided people arriving and leaving. The red-light [[Pemblehov District]] was a common hangout for drug addicts.

==History==
In [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]], after the [[Battle of Antar 4 (Separatist Crisis)|Battle of Antar 4]], many [[Gotal/Legends|Gotals]] fled to Atzerri. This led to a [[Gotal hostage standoff|hostage crisis]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], shortly before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. After the [[Battle of Duro (Clone Wars)|fall]] of [[Duro/Legends|Duro]] during [[Operation Durge's Lance]], [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[HoloNet/Legends|media]] claimed that the neutral Atzerri, along with [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], would become the next victims of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|war machine]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], however, denied the claims in the [[Shadowfeed/Legends|CIS Shadowfeed]], stating that the campaign would stop if the Republic recognized the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="CISSH">{{InsiderCite|76|CIS Shadowfeed Dispatch 15:3:21 Edition}}</ref>

[[File:AtzerriSurface.jpg|thumb|left|200px|An [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-ST]] surveys a local dwelling.]]

In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], it was discovered that the local [[Moff/Legends|Moff]], [[Kalast]], had been feeding top secret [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] information concerning the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] to [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] spies working for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]]. Since he owned an estate on Atzerri, the Empire suspected that Kalast would be located there.<ref name="Star Wars: Empire at War">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]'' Imperial campaign, Mission 10&mdash;"The Traitorous Moff"</ref>

During the conflict, the local population assisted the Rebellion whenever possible, including actively fighting against Imperial garrisons. However, the Empire managed to maintain control of Atzerri despite local resistance. At some point following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Atzerri joined or was annexed into the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

During the [[Black Fleet Crisis]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] visited the planet under the alias [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Li Stonn]] with his [[Fallanassi/Legends|Fallanassi]] companion [[Akanah Norand Goss Pell]]. Tricking Skywalker, Akanah conceived a tale that [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Luke's mother]] was located on Atzerri. In reality Akanah was searching for her father. Abandoning him in the [[Trader's Plaza]], Akanah searched, in vain, for her father.

Bored, Skywalker roamed the sprawling market, discovered the nightclub [[Jabba's Throne Room]]. In here, Skywalker was amused to find a not-so-perfect representation of the galactic gangster's intimidating headquarters. Skywalker was seated underneath a "frozen [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]]" and served a drink from the "slave girl." He finally called it quits after a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] actor failed to impress him with his [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] impression.

Akanah was disappointed to discover her father [[Joreb Goss]] was drug addicted and impoverished. The drug [[Rokna Blue|Rokna blue]] had taken its toll on his mind and he was unable to remember even having a daughter. Skywalker and Akanah left on the ''[[Mud Sloth]]'', both mourning their failure.

The planet was later conquered by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] with the assistance of the [[Peace Brigade]]. It eventually came into affiliation with the Galactic Alliance after the Yuuzhan Vong War.

During the [[Second Galactic Civil War|Confederation-Galactic Alliance War]], Atzerri withdrew its representatives in the [[Galactic Alliance Senate]] after one of their freighters was destroyed as it attempted to run the Alliance's [[Blockade of Corellia]], targeting an Alliance starfighter piloted by [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] as it did so. Solo destroyed the freighter regardless of the fact that its weaponry had been disabled, although he was technically operating under the Rules of Engagement.<ref name="Bloodlines" /> The planet eventually joined the [[Confederation]].<ref name="TEA" />
